title: Repair Context Capsule evaluation contract
scope: Replace prose-equality scoring with canonical typed facts and identifiers for the single-repository and coordinator multi-repository recovery scenarios.
Prove the evaluator against retained WI-0138 outputs without changing or rescoring the historical WI-0138 result.
Make requested, acknowledged configured, and unavailable effective per-turn reasoning effort explicit before freezing any successor live protocol.
acceptance_criteria: Typed schemas use identifiers, integers, arrays, paths, and exact revisions without embedding frozen answers in const or enum values.
A generation-free regression proves punctuation and explanatory prose cannot create false negatives while incorrect IDs, counts, revisions, or actions still fail.
Provider preflight blocks protocol freeze unless the requested model and reasoning configuration are schema-valid and acknowledged before generation; unavailable execution telemetry remains unknown.
No Provider generation occurs until a new exact protocol and separate human approval record exist.

profile_assessment.rationale: This is a bounded evaluator and protocol repair with no Provider generation in the implementation slice; standard workflow preserves independent evaluation before a later live run.

overlap_resolution: WI-0138: historical artifacts and result remain frozen; WI-0139 alone may evolve the current harness and test contract for a new protocol.
